name: PoP Signing-Key Attestation EAT Profile
description: IETF RATS Evidence profile for signing-key attestation: a COSE_Sign1-wrapped CWT in which the device attester key asserts hardware-custody facts about the C2PA content-signing key. The confirmation key (cnf, RFC 8747 claim 8) is the attested C2PA signing public key.
notes: Published under this domain because urn:ietf:params: is IANA-controlled and this profile was never IETF-WG-adopted; a dereferenceable URI needs no registration.
